title: Reverse the word order of a sentence
prompt:
Write reverseWords(String s) returning s with its words in reverse order.
Words are separated by exactly one space; there is no leading, trailing, or doubled
space. Join the reversed words back together with single spaces. The empty string
returns the empty string.

Examples:
  reverseWords("the sky is blue") -> "blue is sky the"
  reverseWords("hello")           -> "hello"
  reverseWords("")                -> ""

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
